args.sql:
WITH digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        compbankref AS customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High' THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        credit_and_compliance AS cc
    JOIN 
        bank_and_transactions AS bt ON cc.compbankref = bt.bankexpref
),
quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref AS customer_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.scoredate) AS start_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.scoredate) AS start_month,
        (start_month - 1) / 3 + 1 AS start_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record AS c
),
engagement_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.start_year,
        qc.start_quarter AS cohort_quarter,
        dn.is_digital_native,
        COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(
            0.4 * cah.produsescore + 
            0.3 * cah.chanusescore + 
            0.2 * bt.bankrelscore + 
            0.1 * (cah.custservint / 10.0)
        ) AS avg_engagement_score,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cah.produsescore > 0.7 THEN dn.customer_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dn.is_digital_native AND cah.produsescore > 0.7 THEN dn.customer_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id), 0) AS high_engagement_digital_percentage
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts AS qc
    JOIN 
        digital_natives AS dn ON qc.customer_id = dn.customer_id
    JOIN 
        credit_accounts_and_history AS cah ON dn.customer_id = cah.histcompref
    JOIN 
        bank_and_transactions AS bt ON cah.histcompref = bt.bankexpref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.start_year, qc.start_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native AS bool_value,
    cohort_size,
    avg_engagement_score AS engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_digital_percentage
FROM 
    engagement_metrics
ORDER BY 
    cohort_quarter, is_digital_native;

        (start_month - 1) / 3 + 1 AS start_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record AS c
),
engagement_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.start_year,
        qc.start_quarter AS cohort_quarter,
        dn.is_digital_native,
        COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(
            0.4 * cah.produsescore + 
            0.3 * cah.chanusescore + 
            0.2 * bt.bankrelscore + 
            0.1 * (cah.custservint / 10.0)
        ) AS avg_engagement_score,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cah.produsescore > 0.7 THEN dn.customer_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dn.is_digital_native AND cah.produsescore > 0.7 THEN dn.customer_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id), 0) AS high_engagement_digital_percentage
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts AS qc
    JOIN 
        digital_natives AS dn ON qc.customer_id = dn.customer_id
    JOIN 
        credit_accounts_and_history AS cah ON dn.customer_id = cah.histcompref
    JOIN 
        bank_and_transactions AS bt ON cah.histcompref = bt.bankexpref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.start_year, qc.start_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native AS bool_value,
    cohort_size,
    avg_engagement_score AS engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_digital_percentage
FROM 
    engagement_metrics
ORDER BY 
    cohort_quarter, is_digital_native;

WITH digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        compbankref AS customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High' THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        credit_and_compliance AS cc
    JOIN 
        bank_and_transactions AS bt ON cc.compbankref = bt.bankexpref
),
quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref AS customer_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.scoredate) AS start_year,
        -- (start_month - 1) / 3 + 1 AS start_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record AS c
),
engagement_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.start_year,
        -- qc.start_quarter AS cohort_quarter,
        dn.is_digital_native,
        COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(
            0.4 * cah.produsescore + 
            0.3 * cah.chanusescore + 
            0.2 * bt.bankrelscore + 
            0.1 * (cah.custservint / 10.0)
        ) AS avg_engagement_score,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cah.produsescore > 0.7 THEN dn.customer_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dn.is_digital_native AND cah.produsescore > 0.7 THEN dn.customer_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dn.customer_id), 0) AS high_engagement_digital_percentage
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts AS qc
    JOIN 
        digital_natives AS dn ON qc.customer_id = dn.customer_id
    JOIN 
        credit_accounts_and_history AS cah ON dn.customer_id = cah.histcompref
    JOIN 
        bank_and_transactions AS bt ON cah.histcompref = bt.bankexpref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.start_year, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    -- cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native AS bool_value,
    cohort_size,
    avg_engagement_score AS engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_digital_percentage
FROM 
    engagement_metrics
ORDER BY 
    is_digital_native;
